jobs.description: List of mirror jobs to configure. Each job defines a single FTP mirror task. Required fields: host, remote_dir. Local directory defaults to current working directory unless --no-delete is used, in which case it may be omitted only with --interactive (but not in config file). In config file context, local_dir is required unless --interactive is used (but --interactive is not supported in config files per documented behavior). Therefore, local_dir must be specified in config file jobs unless --interactive is used (but interactive mode is not applicable to config file usage per manpage). To keep config file sane, we require local_dir as string in each job unless interactive mode is explicitly allowed (not recommended for config file use), but per manpage interactive mode reads from stdin — thus unsuitable for config files. Therefore: local_dir required for all config file jobs. We model this as required in practice, but schema allows optional with clear note in default: none, meaning 'not specified' and user must supply. We default to none to enforce explicit declaration, but in sample_values we always supply it. Schema design: allow optional but strongly encourage explicit definition in sample_values and usage notes. In values_schema we define it as string with no default (empty string would be invalid), but in practice every job must specify local_dir when used in config file context. Since we're modeling a config file template (not CLI args), we treat 'local_dir' as required per typical service usage. However, the spec requires that defaults be bare scalars, so we use 'default': null (but JSON doesn't allow null as bare scalar in strict sense — wait: JSON spec does allow null. However, instructions say: 'default' MUST be a BARE scalar (string/number/bool) or array — NEVER a nested object'. So 'null' is not allowed. Therefore we must avoid null.
